## Why This Is Asked
Tests the ability to design tenant-scoped runtime behavior using simple primitives (ConfigMap + sidecar) and validation via webhook, a common CNF pattern.

## Key Concepts
- Tenant isolation via per-namespace ConfigMap
- Runtime feature flags controlled by a sidecar
- Validation via admission webhook
- Minimal end-to-end test within one namespace

## Code Example
```yaml
# CNF feature flag ConfigMap
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: cnf-features
  namespace: tenant-a
data:
  flags.json: |
    { "experimental": true }
```

```yaml
# CNF deployment with sidecar (simplified)
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: cnf-app
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: cnf
        image: cnf:latest
        env:
        - name: tenantID
          value: "tenant-a"
      - name: feature-sidecar
        image: feature-sidecar:latest
        volumeMounts:
        - name: flags
          mountPath: /etc/cnf/flags.json
          subPath: flags.json
      volumes:
      - name: flags
        configMap:
          name: cnf-features
```

## Why This Is Asked
Evaluates real-world CNF governance under multi-region and partition scenarios, focusing on provenance, attestation, and policy enforcement using Sigstore, SBOM, Kyverno/OPA, and distributed consistency.

## Key Concepts
- Sigstore/cosign SBOM provenance
- Quorum-based replication and central verifier
- Kyverno/OPA regional policy gates
- TPM/IMA attestation mechanisms
- Partition-tolerant rollout strategies
- In-namespace test scaffolding for rollback safety

## Code Example
```yaml
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata:
  name: require-attestation-sbom
spec:
  validationFailureAction: enforce
  rules:
  - name: attestation-sbom-check
    match:
      resources:
        kinds: ["Deployment"]
    validate:
      message: "Deployment upgrade requires attestationDigest and sbomDigest"
      pattern:
        metadata.annotations.attestationDigest: "*"
        metadata.annotations.sbomDigest: "*"
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you model failure modes during partition events and ensure eventual consistency?
- What metrics and dashboards would you expose to detect drift between regional verifiers and the central ledger?

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
```

```yaml
          "pattern": "^/v1/(.*)$",
          "replacement": "/tenant1/v1/$1"

kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: cnf-gateway
  namespace: cnf-gateway

apiVersion: apps/v1

metadata:
  name: cnf-gateway

spec:
  replicas: 2

```
